ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel field (estimated >90%) with localized high-intensity circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark low-intensity field across both lobes. High-contrast white circular spots mapped in a diagonal linear sequence on the right lobe and scattered rings and dots on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate 105-degree interior angle and significant depth relative to the fluke horizontal baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary characterized by high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations and several deep vertical notches, most prominent on the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primarily linear sweep with low-level convexity extending from the median notch towards the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of high-contrast white circular pixel clusters. Right lobe features a distinctive diagonal chain of approximately 7 spots. Left lobe features multiple scattered circular and ring-like scars.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions localized in the upper regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular high-contrast pixel clusters at distal lobe tips causing significant topographical disruption. Distinct large-scale indentation on the left lobe trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular ring-shaped scars located on the upper medial region of the left lobe.
